```{r Read the Data File}
exp.data <- read_excel("Study_1_Data_Cleaned.xlsx", guess_max = 5000)

demographics <- read_excel("dyad_attributes.xlsx", guess_max = 50)

exp.data$session_number <- as.factor(exp.data$session_number)
exp.data$exp <- as.factor(exp.data$exp)
exp.data$subject <- as.factor(exp.data$subject)
exp.data$partner <- as.factor(exp.data$partner)
exp.data$condition <- as.factor(exp.data$condition)
exp.data$condition <- relevel(exp.data$condition, ref = "PA")
exp.data$total_trial <- as.numeric(exp.data$total_trial)
exp.data$trial <- as.numeric(exp.data$trial)
exp.data$trial_type <- as.factor(exp.data$trial_type)
exp.data$equity <- as.factor(exp.data$equity)
exp.data$tray <- as.character(exp.data$tray)
exp.data$success <- as.factor(exp.data$success)
exp.data$subject_eat <- as.factor(exp.data$subject_eat)
exp.data$partner_eat <- as.factor(exp.data$partner_eat)
exp.data$choice_switch <- as.factor(exp.data$choice_switch)
exp.data$give_up <- as.factor(exp.data$give_up)
exp.data$subject_hand <- as.factor(exp.data$subject_hand)
exp.data$partner_hand <- as.factor(exp.data$partner_hand)
exp.data$subject_refusal <- as.factor(exp.data$subject_refusal)
exp.data$partner_refusal <- as.factor(exp.data$partner_refusal)
exp.data$CSI <- as.numeric(exp.data$CSI)
exp.data$rank_relative <- as.factor(exp.data$rank_relative)
exp.data$kin <- as.factor(exp.data$kin)
exp.data$dyad_sex <- as.factor(exp.data$dyad_sex)
```

```{r Divide Data into Exp 1 and Exp 2 Data}

  select(-n_trials_exp1_PP)

# Experiment 2 Data only
```

```{r Check whether preferences were different from chance (0.50) - GROUP LEVEL}
# GROUP LEVEL
library(dplyr)
exp_trials <- subset(exp.1.data, trial_type == "exp" & condition == "PP")

chance_model <- glmer(
  coop_binary ~ 1 + (1 | subject),
  data = exp_trials,
  family = binomial
)

summary(chance_model)

plogis(fixef(chance_model))

# Odds ratio for intercept-only chance model
OR <- exp(fixef(chance_model))

# Wald 95% CI for odds ratio
CI <- exp(confint(chance_model, parm = "(Intercept)", method = "Wald"))

data.frame(
  OR = OR,
  lower_95_CI = CI[, 1],
  upper_95_CI = CI[, 2],
  p_value = summary(chance_model)$coefficients["(Intercept)", "Pr(>|z|)"]
)
```


```{r Check whether preferences were different from chance (0.50) - INDIVIDUAL LEVEL}
# INDIVIDUAL LEVEL
# bootstrap function
bootstrap_subject <- function(x, R = 5000, chance = 0.5){
  obs <- mean(x)
  sims <- replicate(R, mean(sample(x, replace = TRUE)))
  ci <- quantile(sims, c(.025, .975))
  p <- 2 * min(
    mean(sims >= chance),
    mean(sims <= chance)
  )
  
  data.frame(
    prob = obs,
    lower = ci[1],
    upper = ci[2],
    p_value = p
  )
}

# run bootstrap for each subject
results <- exp_trials %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  summarise(bootstrap_subject(coop_binary), .groups = "drop")

results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    classification = case_when(
      lower > 0.5 ~ "above chance",
      upper < 0.5 ~ "below chance",
      TRUE ~ "not different from chance"
    )
  )

results

table(exp_trials$coop_binary, exp_trials$subject)
```

```{r Exp 1 Model 1 - Task Comprehension and Experience}
# Scale numeric variables
# Trial Number 
exp.1.data$total_trial_z <- scale(exp.1.data$total_trial_subject,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
exp.1.data$total_trial_condition_z <- scale(exp.1.data$total_trial_subject_condition,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
exp.1.data$total_trial_trial_type_z <- scale(exp.1.data$total_trial_subject_trialtype,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# CSI
exp.1.data$CSI_z <- scale(exp.1.data$CSI,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# Null Model 1
NULL_EXP1 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.1.data)

# Model 1
M1 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ trial_type * condition + total_trial_trial_type_z*trial_type + 
                (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.1.data,
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))

anova(NULL_EXP1, M1, test = "Chisq")

```
```{r Model 1 Diagnostics Check}
library(DHARMa)

M1@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages # Should return NULL
isSingular(M1, tol = 1e-4) # Should return FALSE
VarCorr(M1) # Inspects Random Effect Variances

set.seed(123)
sim_M1 <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = M1,
  n = 1000
)
plot(sim_M1) # should follow diagonal and all tests should be N.S.

plotResiduals(sim_M1, exp.1.data$total_trial_trial_type_z)
plotResiduals(sim_M1, exp.1.data$condition)

```


```{r Model 1 Summary and Interactions}
# Compare to pre-registered model and compare to null model
anova(NULL_EXP1, M1, test = "Chisq")

summary(M1)

Anova(M1, type = 3)

library(sjPlot)
tab_model(M1,
          show.est = TRUE, show.ci = 0.95,
          show.p = TRUE, p.style = "numeric",
          show.se = FALSE, show.r2 = TRUE,
          show.zeroinf = FALSE,
          show.re.var = FALSE, show.icc = FALSE,
          title = "Logistic Regression Predicting Joint Tray Selection from Relationship Variables")

# Probe the Trial Type x Condition interaction
EMM_M1 <- emmeans(M1, ~ trial_type * condition, type = "response")
EMM_M1
pairs(EMM_M1, by = "trial_type", adjust = "holm", type = "response")

# Probe the Trial Type x Trial Number interaction
learning_slopes <- emtrends(M1, ~ trial_type, var = "total_trial_trial_type_z")
learning_slopes
pairs(learning_slopes, adjust = "holm")
learning_OR <- summary(learning_slopes, infer = TRUE)
learning_OR$OR <- exp(learning_OR$total_trial_trial_type_z.trend)
learning_OR

rm(EMM_M1, learning_slopes, learning_OR)
```

```{r Indiviudal Level Analysis of Joint Tray Selections}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)

trial_types <- c("exp", "joint_only", "solo_only")

# Conduct Exact Fisher Tests for each monkey to determine which monkeys selected the Joint tray significantly more in the Partner Present condition compared to the Partner Absent condition
test_results <- exp.1.data %>%
  group_by(subject, trial_type) %>%      # group per subject × trial_type
  nest() %>%                             # nest trials for each subject × trial_type
  mutate(
    tab = map(data, ~ table(.x$condition, .x$coop_binary)),
    test = map(tab, ~ if(all(dim(.x) == 2)) fisher.test(.x) else NA),
    p.value = map_dbl(test, ~ if(is.list(.x)) .x$p.value else NA_real_),
    odds_ratio = map_dbl(test, ~ if(is.list(.x) && !is.null(.x$estimate)) .x$estimate else NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(subject, trial_type, p.value, odds_ratio)

# Only look at the experimental trials, the other trial values are not meaningful for your Research Question
test_results_exp <- test_results %>%
  filter(trial_type == "exp")

test_results_joint_only <- test_results %>%
  filter(trial_type == "joint_only")

rm(test_results)

test_results_exp
test_results_joint_only
#Odds ratios > 1.00 with significant p-values indicate individuals who chose the joint tray significantly more in the PP than the PA condition
```

```{r Exp 1 Model 2 - Social Factors}
# Subset to PP Condition ONLY {Since this is the only condition where dyad level parameters matter}
exp.1.data.pp <- subset(exp.1.data, condition == "PP")

exp.1.data.pp$dyad_order <- as.factor(exp.1.data.pp$dyad_order)

# Null Model
NULL_EXP1_M2 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.1.data.pp)

# Model 2
M2 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ trial_type*CSI_z + trial_type*rank_relative + trial_type*kin + dyad_order +
                (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.1.data.pp,
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))

anova(NULL_EXP1_M2, M2, test = "Chisq")
```

```{r Model 2 Diagnostics}
M2@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages # Should return NULL
isSingular(M2, tol = 1e-4) # Should return FALSE
VarCorr(M2) # Inspects Random Effect Variances

set.seed(123)
sim_M2 <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = M2,
  n = 1000
)
plot(sim_M2) # should follow diagonal and all tests should be N.S.

testUniformity(sim_M2)
testDispersion(sim_M2)
testOutliers(sim_M2)
```

```{r Reciprocity Correlation}
# Only examine the second pairings
exp.1.recip <- subset(exp.1.data, dyad_order == 2)
# Only examine the Partner Present Data
exp.1.recip <- subset(exp.1.recip, condition == "PP")
# Only examine the experimental trials
exp.1.recip <- subset(exp.1.recip, trial_type == "exp")

library(dplyr)
reciprocity_summary <- exp.1.recip %>%
  group_by(subject, partner) %>%
  summarise(
    joint_tray_prop = mean(coop_binary),           # proportion of joint choices
    first_subject_coop_prop = first(first_subject_coop_prop)  # previous cooperation
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Logistic regression
reciprocity_model <- glm(coop_binary ~ first_subject_coop_prop,
                   data = exp.1.recip,
                   family = binomial)

summary(reciprocity_model)

          show.est = TRUE, show.ci = 0.95,
          show.p = TRUE, p.style = "numeric",

          show.zeroinf = FALSE,

rm(reciprocity_model, reciprocity_summary, exp.1.recip)
```

```{r Testing for above chance performance on all trial types at the group-level}
library(dplyr)
exp2_PP <- subset(exp.2.data, condition == "PP")

chance_model_exp2 <- exp2_PP %>%
  group_split(trial_type)

model_results <- lapply(chance_model_exp2, function(df){

  m <- glmer(
    coop_binary ~ 1 + (1 | subject),
    data = df,
    family = binomial
  )
  
  data.frame(
    trial_type = unique(df$trial_type),
    log_odds = fixef(m)[1],
    prob = plogis(fixef(m)[1]),
    z = summary(m)$coefficients[1,3],
    p_value = summary(m)$coefficients[1,4]
  )
})

group_results <- bind_rows(model_results)

group_results
```

```{r Test for above chance performance on all trial types at the individual level}
bootstrap_subject <- function(x, R = 5000, chance = 0.5){
  obs <- mean(x)

  sims <- replicate(R, mean(sample(x, replace = TRUE)))

  ci <- quantile(sims, c(.025, .975))

  p <- 2 * min(
    mean(sims >= chance),
    mean(sims <= chance)
  )

  p <- min(p, 1)

  data.frame(
    prob = obs,
    lower = ci[1],
    upper = ci[2],
    p_value = p
  )
}
results_exp2 <- exp2_PP %>%
  group_by(trial_type, subject) %>%
  summarise(bootstrap_subject(coop_binary), .groups = "drop")

results_exp2 <- results_exp2 %>%
  mutate(
    classification = case_when(
      lower > 0.5 ~ "above chance",
      upper < 0.5 ~ "below chance",
      TRUE ~ "not different from chance"
    )
  )

print(results_exp2)


```

```{r Export the individual outputs into a table}
results_exp2 <- exp2_PP %>%
  group_by(trial_type, subject) %>%
  summarise(bootstrap_subject(coop_binary), .groups = "drop")

table2_exp2 <- results_exp2 %>%
  mutate(
    trial_type_clean = recode(
      trial_type,
      "medium_medium" = "Medium/Medium",
      "high_high" = "High/High",
      "low_low" = "Low/Low",
      "partner_high" = "Partner-High",
      "partner_low" = "Partner-Low",
      "altruism" = "Subject-Low"
    ),
    sig = case_when(
      p_value < .001 ~ "***",
      p_value < .01  ~ "**",
      p_value < .05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    preference = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", prob), sig)
  ) %>%
  select(subject, trial_type_clean, preference) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = trial_type_clean,
    values_from = preference
  ) %>%
  select(
    subject,
    `Medium/Medium`,
    `High/High`,
    `Low/Low`,
    `Partner-High`,
    `Partner-Low`,
    `Subject-Low`
  )

table2_exp2
print(table2_exp2, n = Inf)
```





```{r Model 3 - Trial type and Condition}
# Scale numeric variables
# Trial Number 
exp.2.data$total_trial_z <- scale(exp.2.data$total_trial_subject,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
exp.2.data$total_trial_condition_z <- scale(exp.2.data$total_trial_subject_condition,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
exp.2.data$total_trial_trial_type_z <- scale(exp.2.data$total_trial_subject_trialtype,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
# CSI
exp.2.data$CSI_z <- scale(exp.2.data$CSI,
                                  center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

# Null Model
NULL_EXP2_M3 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.2.data)

M3 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ trial_type * condition + total_trial_trial_type_z*trial_type +
                  (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.2.data,
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))

anova(NULL_EXP2_M3, M3)

```

```{r Model 3 Diagnostics}
M3_vif <- lm(coop_binary ~ trial_type + condition + total_trial_subject_trialtype, data = exp.2.data)
vif(M3_vif)

M3@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages # Should return NULL
isSingular(M3, tol = 1e-4) # Should return FALSE
VarCorr(M3) # Inspects Random Effect Variances

set.seed(123)
sim_M3 <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = M3,
  n = 1000
)
plot(sim_M3) # should follow diagonal and all tests should be N.S.

testUniformity(sim_M3)
testDispersion(sim_M3)
testOutliers(sim_M3)
```

```{r Model 3 Summary and Interactions}
# Set reference level
exp.2.data$trial_type <- relevel(exp.2.data$trial_type,
                                 ref = "medium_medium")
summary(M3)

Anova(M3, type = 3)

library(sjPlot)
tab_model(M3,
          show.est = TRUE, show.ci = 0.95,
          show.p = TRUE, p.style = "numeric",
          show.se = TRUE, show.r2 = TRUE,
          show.zeroinf = FALSE,
          show.re.var = FALSE, show.icc = FALSE,
          title = "Logistic Regression Predicting Joint Tray Selection in Exp 2")

# Probe significant Trial Type x Condition interaction for comprehension to see if PA is lower than PP
EMM_M3_condition <- emmeans(M3, ~ trial_type * condition, type = "response")
EMM_M3_condition
pairs(EMM_M3_condition, by = "trial_type", adjust = "holm", type = "response")

# Now test for inequity using planned comparisons
EMM <- emmeans(M3, ~ trial_type | condition)
ineq_contrasts <- contrast(
  EMM,
  method = "pairwise",
  ref = "medium_medium",
  by = "condition"
)

summary(ineq_contrasts,
        type = "response",
        infer = TRUE,
        adjust = "holm")

PP_inequity_contrasts <- subset(
  summary(ineq_contrasts, type = "response", infer = TRUE, adjust = "holm"),
  condition == "PP"
)

# Inequity Results
print(PP_inequity_contrasts)

PP_inequity_contrasts
# Changes in condition
# Probe the Trial Type x Trial Number interaction
learning_slopes_M3 <- emtrends(M3, ~ trial_type, var = "total_trial_trial_type_z")
learning_slopes_M3
pairs(learning_slopes_M3, adjust = "holm")
learning_OR_M3 <- summary(learning_slopes_M3, infer = TRUE)
learning_OR_M3$OR <- exp(learning_OR_M3$total_trial_trial_type_z.trend)
learning_OR_M3
```

```{r Figure 5 - Visualization of Model 3}
library(dplyr)

coop_exp2 <- exp.data %>%
  filter(exp == 2) %>%
  group_by(subject, partner, trial_type, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    coop_count = sum(tray == "coop"),

    prop_coop = coop_count / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

coop_exp2 <- coop_exp2 %>%
  filter(trial_type != "solo_only")

library(Rmisc)
coop_summary_exp_2 <- summarySE(
  data = coop_exp2,

  na.rm = TRUE)

coop_summary_exp_2$equity <- ifelse(coop_summary_exp_2$trial_type == "medium_medium" | coop_summary_exp_2$trial_type == "high_high" | coop_summary_exp_2$trial_type == "low_low", "equal", "inequity")

detach("package:Rmisc")
detach("package:plyr")

# Determines the order of the variables on the X-axis

  coop_summary_exp_2$trial_type,

             "partner_low",

# Figure 6: Absolute Value Low/Low High/High and Medium/Medium
```

```{r Exp 2 Model 4 - Social Factors}
# Subset to PP Condition ONLY {Since this is the only condition where dyad level parameters matter}
exp.2.data.pp <- subset(exp.2.data, condition == "PP")

exp.2.data.pp$dyad_order <- as.factor(exp.2.data.pp$dyad_order)

# Null Model
NULL_EXP2_M4 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.2.data.pp)

# Model 2
M4 <- glmer(coop_binary ~ trial_type*CSI_z + trial_type*rank_relative + trial_type*kin + trial_type*dyad_order +
                (1 | subject) + (1 | partner),
        family = binomial(link = "logit"), data = exp.2.data.pp,
        control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000)))

anova(NULL_EXP2_M4, M4)

```
```{r Model 4 Diagnostics}
M4_vif <- lm(coop_binary ~ trial_type + CSI + rank_relative + kin + dyad_order, data = exp.2.data.pp)
vif(M4_vif)

M4@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages # Should return NULL
isSingular(M4, tol = 1e-4) # Should return FALSE
VarCorr(M4) # Inspects Random Effect Variances

set.seed(123)
sim_M4 <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = M4,
  n = 1000
)
plot(sim_M4) # should follow diagonal and all tests should be N.S.

testUniformity(sim_M4)
testDispersion(sim_M4)
testOutliers(sim_M4)
```

```{r Model 4 Summary and Interactions}
CSI_OR
```
